policy: Explicit reviewed parallel allowlist; new/unreviewed files warn and run exclusively, never disappear. F and N share a resource-limited pool (default request eight, configurable 1–32); E drains that pool. No directory/name inference. Original deadlines, assertions and host opt-in skips remain unchanged.
reviewBasis: Native entries use the source-audited per-file inventory in the coordinator's parallel-test design (runtime 14/15/3/5 split); F entries were read with their implementation imports. Initial scheduling reviews assumed two workers, not proven timing margins. The requested eight-worker default still requires native execution acceptance with unchanged deadlines. Re-review when resource/fixture behavior changes.

Read test and git-exec.ts: environment-object sanitation only, no actual Git invocation.
Owned private persistent-state contention; per-file private agent/home prevents cross-worker reuse.
Private ephemeral loopback port 0 and intentional invalid-host failures; no shared server/outbound credentials. Sandbox loopback remains a capability risk.
Original whole file remains INCLUDED: real node-pty/shell creation as well as fakes. No new skip; PTY/shell sandbox failures must fail. Separate e2e terminal SCRIPT is opt-in.
Incomplete offline audit: stubs pi.dev but deletes PI_OFFLINE and delegates unmatched fetch; included conservatively, no credentials supplied, Nix sandbox enforces external-network boundary.
Known offline-contract failures must remain visible; included exclusive, no network enablement or skip workaround.

Shared acceptance-harness regressions mutate test-process umask/exit status and exercise owned child SIGTERM/SIGKILL lifecycle; exclusive avoids nested process contention. No browser/terminal acceptance substitution.

Owned process supervision and FD-safe cleanup contracts launch concurrent tiny children and exercise interruption; exclusive avoids nesting with SDK-sensitive acceptance. No browser acceptance substitution.
Runner-only mechanics deliberately launch tiny two-worker subprocesses, exercise SIGINT/TERM and mutate sentinel env/umask; exclusive avoids nested pool oversubscription. No SDK/native proof.
